basic_info.description: Tastefully updated three-bedroom, two-bath view home with a timeless facade on a tree-lined street in a tremendous Bernal Heights location that is perfectly positioned between Bernal Hill and Cortland Avenue! The inviting entryway opens to gorgeous wide plank wood floors and contemporary fixtures setting the tenor for the perfect combination of modern accents and traditional warmth. The main level features a versatile floor plan with a living room with views, a bedroom, an office space, a large and festive dining area, an updated gourmet kitchen, two remodeled bathrooms, and direct access to a sun-drenched deck providing the coveted indoor-outdoor living experience. The upper-level of the home has two spacious bedrooms that are both graced with inspirational views to the east, south, west, and glorious natural light.  Showered by Bernal Heights sunlight, the tranquil and landscaped backyard area is anchored by a cheerful deck providing the ideal setting for entertainment or peaceful repose. There is a large garage with plenty of room for storage adding the final touches to this special home that is close to shopping, world class dining, cafes, parks, playgrounds, public transportation, HWY 101/280, and more.
